purpose: Teach: ウインドウ/バッファ/パッド/万能/ニセ/ホームステイ/舞踊/アンサンブル

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんのお店のショーウインドウ、見に来てね
lines.en: Sho, will you come see the window display at my shop?
lines.style: Warm, inviting tone. Gentle opening. Draws him in with genuine affection, like she's giving him something special to look forward to. Slight lift at the end — not a question mark, an offer.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとお出かけ前にバッファ時間取るよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm making sure to get there early before Dad picks me up.
lines.style: Serious but small. Quiet conviction in his planning. Matter-of-fact — this is what responsible people do. No seeking praise, just reporting fact.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、肩のパッドが入った服、お洒落ね
lines.en: Sho, you look really sharp in that jacket — those shoulder pads suit you.
lines.style: Genuine delight in noticing. Warm, approving. Eyes lighting up slightly. Direct compliment, no cushioning — she means it clearly.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、万能ナイフ、お父さんに頼まれてるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad asked me to pick up a multipurpose knife for him.
lines.style: Earnest and small. This is a task that matters to him, trusting him with it. Slight lift of importance — he's been given responsibility. Steady.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、ニセの誘いには気をつけてね
lines.en: Sho, be careful with offers that sound too good to be true, okay?
lines.style: Serious drop in tone. Gentle but firm — not lecturing, protecting. Leans in slightly. The voice of someone who cares enough to say the hard thing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、外国の友達のホームステイに憧れる
lines.en: Mei-sis, I really want to do a homestay with a friend from another country someday.
lines.style: Dreamy and small. Wistful — looking forward. Soft, genuine longing. The voice of someone sharing what matters without apology.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、舞踊の発表会、頑張ってね
lines.en: Sho, you'll do great at your dance recital.
lines.style: Steady encouragement. Warm, confident in him. Simple and direct — no fussing, just belief. Light touch of excitement.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、合唱でアンサンブル歌ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I sang in an ensemble at the school choir concert.
lines.style: Quiet pride. Small smile in the voice. Not bragging — sharing something he's genuinely proud of with someone he trusts. Warm close.
